ops.title: TCC durable-identity fix: Phase 0 portal artifacts (App IDs, DevID profiles, CI secrets)
ops.body:
Phase 0 of the per-upgrade TCC re-prompt fix (cc-pool + cookiesync) completed 2026-07-17 via browser automation on team SXKCTF23Q2.

**App IDs registered** (explicit, App Groups capability enabled):
- `com.yasyf.cc-pool.status` — "cc-pool Status Host"
- `com.yasyf.cc-pool.status.fileprovider` — "cc-pool FileProvider Extension"
- `com.yasyf.cc-pool.daemon` — "cc-pool Daemon"

**Developer ID provisioning profiles** (macOS, Developer ID Application cert exp 2031-06-20; all three authorize `com.apple.security.application-groups: SXKCTF23Q2.*`, which covers `SXKCTF23Q2.ccp`):
- `cc-pool Daemon DevID` — UUID f60d561c-4547-4bae-b7e3-ce0bb28fe9b3, expires 2044-07-11
- `cc-pool Status Host DevID` — UUID 4384a459-99ff-4617-8db8-e84c12798558, expires 2044-07-11
- `cc-pool FileProvider DevID` — UUID 2cb3be8b-0f10-4201-a5a1-b65ada2da200, expires 2044-07-11

**CI secrets set on yasyf/cc-pool** (base64 of the .provisionprofile): `MACOS_PROFILE_HOST_APP`, `MACOS_PROFILE_FP_APPEX`, `MACOS_PROFILE_DAEMON`.

**Load-bearing**: the widget release build resolves profiles by embedded Name — the secrets MUST decode to profiles literally named "cc-pool Status Host DevID" / "cc-pool FileProvider DevID" (release.yml installs them by UUID filename, xcodebuild matches PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER by name). Rotation: re-mint in the portal with the SAME name, re-set the secret; specifier names stay stable. Profiles expire 2044 (not cert-bound) — R2 closed.

Local copies (session-scoped, not durable): /Users/yasyf/Code/.wt/profiles/.
